pages.title: Autonomous Calibrator
pages.text: A field calibrator with a superintelligence wired into it, installed permanently into a controller. It watches the drifting tuning, corrects it, and repairs containment without being asked. It takes a share of the power for itself, which seems fair.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Tuning every machine by hand was exhausting. On the Femtoscale Assembly Line I fused a Field Calibrator with a Superintelligence Core and a Cosmic Processor. It has not needed me since.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Superintelligence.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Predictive Lattice Governor, Theoretical Notes I.
